title: Cartoon by F. H. Townsend
content: Frederick Henry Townsend (1868-1920) drew this cartoon for the British humor magazinePunch.OUR EVENING ART CLASSES HAVE COMMENCEDMr. X. (our dear Professor, who always puts things so tellingly):"In conclusion, I can only repeat what I said last Term—'It's all light and shade, Ladies, whether you're painting abattle-piece, a bunch of grapes, or a child in prayer!'"
